name: Is a new shower worth it, or should I keep the tub?

mainEntity.name: Is a new shower worth it, or should I keep the tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: A well-planned shower installation can improve daily use, make the bathroom easier to clean, and create a more modern look. If accessibility matters, features like a low-threshold entry, grab bars, a bench, or a handheld shower can make the space safer and more comfortable.
acceptedAnswer.description: A new shower can improve convenience, cleaning, and safety. If accessibility matters, add features like a low curb, bench, or handheld shower.
